workouts.name: Home Strength A · Foundation
workouts.notes: 居家功夫 Home Kung Fu, Squat · push · hinge · pull · core. 7 min warm-up first.

items.notes: Sit between the heels, chest proud, knees track the toes. Video: IU Health Sports Performance, https://youtu.be/8uoaYwS6iFM
Hands on a sturdy table or bed. Body one straight plank. Video: Fit Father Project, https://youtu.be/CCZGD55NxGo
Drive through heels, squeeze glutes 1 s at the top.
Face down, thumbs up, lift arms into Y, T, W. Slow.
Ribs down, glutes tight. Stop when the hips sag.
Low back pressed to the floor the whole time.

workouts.name: Home Strength B · Foundation
workouts.notes: 居家功夫 Home Kung Fu, Single leg · push · posterior chain · anti-rotation. 7 min warm-up first.

items.notes: Step back, both knees to 90°. Hold a wall if balance wobbles.
From the knees, hips in line. Chest to fist-height off the floor. Video: Fit Father Project, https://youtu.be/CCZGD55NxGo
Lift chest and legs a few cm. Long neck, eyes down.
From knees at first; straight line head to knee.
Slow and controlled; plank stays still.
Back and arms against the wall; slide up without arching.

workouts.name: Home Strength C · Foundation
workouts.notes: 居家功夫 Home Kung Fu, Kung fu strength · legs · core · crawling. 7 min warm-up first.

items.notes: Static lunge: drop straight down, back knee hovers.
Use the hardest version you can do for 5+ clean reps. Video: Fit Father Project, https://youtu.be/CCZGD55NxGo
马步: feet 2 shoulder-widths, thighs toward parallel, back upright. Video: Shifu Yan Lei, https://youtu.be/T-m7-ikRIYI
Reach long; don't let the hips rotate.
Tuck version: knees bent, low back flat.
Knees 3 cm off the floor; small steps forward and back.

workouts.name: Shaolin Basics · Foundation
workouts.notes: Stances, punches, kicks, stretch. 7 min warm-up first.

items.notes: 马步 horse · 弓步 bow · 虚步 empty · 仆步 drop · 歇步 crossed. Both sides where it applies. Video: Shifu Yan Lei, https://youtu.be/w-4n7cbNXZw
冲拳 from 马步: fist turns over at the end, other fist pulls to the hip. Video: Shaolin Temple UK, https://youtu.be/x56TN5EtNzg
弓步冲拳: drive from the back heel through the hip. Video: Shaolin Temple UK, https://youtu.be/x56TN5EtNzg
正踢腿: straight leg swings up, toes pulled back. Walk the length of the room. Video: Wang Shifu, https://youtu.be/CZe5hDY-wwg
外摆腿 outside / 里合腿 inside. Big, relaxed arc. Video: Master Song Kung Fu, https://youtu.be/H71OH6wGVVs
弹腿: chamber the knee, snap the instep out, recoil. Video: Wang Shifu, https://youtu.be/CZe5hDY-wwg
Finisher. Write the time down. Video: Shifu Yan Lei, https://youtu.be/T-m7-ikRIYI
Hamstrings, hip flexors, butterfly, side splits. Easy breathing. Video: Warrior Martial Arts, https://youtu.be/UiO3WBOxUsc

workouts.name: Forms & Tai Chi · Foundation
workouts.notes: 五步拳 then Tai Chi. 5 min warm-up first.

items.notes: 五步拳. Learn 3 moves a week (see the skill track). Slow, then smooth. Video: David Bao, https://youtu.be/G3-Drrupfxo
Dr Lam's beginner lesson: warm-up and qigong first, then movements 1–2. Video: Dr Paul Lam, Tai Chi Productions, https://youtu.be/hIOHGrYCEJ4

workouts.name: Home Strength A · Build
workouts.notes: 居家功夫 Home Kung Fu, Squat · push · hinge · pull · core. 7 min warm-up first.

items.notes: 2 s pause at the bottom. Add a backpack if 15 feels easy. Video: IU Health Sports Performance, https://youtu.be/8uoaYwS6iFM
Full push-ups; back to incline for the last set if needed. Video: Calisthenicmovement, https://youtu.be/X7VxeubJSsA
Hips stay level; other knee hugged to the chest.
Hold each top position 2 s.
Add a shoulder tap every 5 s once 60 s is easy.
Exhale fully as the arm and leg reach.

workouts.name: Home Strength B · Build
workouts.notes: 居家功夫 Home Kung Fu, Single leg · push · posterior chain · anti-rotation. 7 min warm-up first.

items.notes: Rear foot on a chair or sofa. Front shin near vertical.
Stop two short of failure. Note the number each week. Video: Calisthenicmovement, https://youtu.be/X7VxeubJSsA
Add a slow swim (arms Y → W) for the last 10 s.
Full side plank from the feet.
Pick up the pace while the hips stay level.

workouts.name: Home Strength C · Build
workouts.notes: 居家功夫 Home Kung Fu, Kung fu strength · legs · core · crawling. 7 min warm-up first.

items.notes: Side-to-side deep squat; builds the drop stance (仆步).
Try 1 set with hands narrow (diamond-ish). Video: Calisthenicmovement, https://youtu.be/X7VxeubJSsA
Lower each week. Breathe slowly through the nose. Video: Shifu Yan Lei, https://youtu.be/T-m7-ikRIYI
Hold the reach 2 s.
Straighten the legs as you get stronger.
Add lateral crawls on the last set.

workouts.name: Shaolin Basics · Build
workouts.notes: Stances, punches, kicks, stretch. 7 min warm-up first.

items.notes: Lower stances. Flow from one to the next without standing up. Video: Shifu Yan Lei, https://youtu.be/w-4n7cbNXZw
Last 10 at speed; keep the stance still. Video: Shaolin Temple UK, https://youtu.be/x56TN5EtNzg
Exhale sharply on each punch. Video: Shaolin Temple UK, https://youtu.be/x56TN5EtNzg
Height comes from flexibility, not momentum. Video: Wang Shifu, https://youtu.be/CZe5hDY-wwg
Video: Master Song Kung Fu, https://youtu.be/H71OH6wGVVs
Add a punch with the kick: 弹踢冲拳 from Wu Bu Quan. Video: Wang Shifu, https://youtu.be/CZe5hDY-wwg
Target: 2 minutes by week 8. Video: Shifu Yan Lei, https://youtu.be/T-m7-ikRIYI
Video: Warrior Martial Arts, https://youtu.be/UiO3WBOxUsc

workouts.name: Forms & Tai Chi · Build
workouts.notes: 五步拳 then Tai Chi. 5 min warm-up first.

items.notes: Whole form, both directions, 5–8 times. Film one run in week 8. Video: Shi Heng Yi Online, https://youtu.be/2F_4JKcmPX0
Continue Dr Lam's beginner series, one new movement a week. Video: Dr Paul Lam, Tai Chi Productions, https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLMypbNPFKGgRcuiKMpj79cE-VHP4I2zhB
Optional on rest days. Gentle; leave refreshed, not tired. Video: Shi Heng Yi Online, https://youtu.be/UpN3AcXLSSk
